test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: bump_build appends .0 for non-numeric last segment."""


def test_bump_build_non_numeric_last_segment():
    """When the last dot-separated segment of build metadata is not purely numeric
    (e.g. 'alpha'), bump_build must append '.0' so the result is a raised build."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '1.2.3+alpha.0', f"Expected 1.2.3+alpha.0, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_numeric_last_segment_increments():
    """When the last dot-separated segment IS purely numeric, it increments normally."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '1.2.3+build.10', f"Expected 1.2.3+build.10, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_with_prerelease_and_numeric_build():
    """A version with both prerelease and numeric build metadata increments correctly."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10', f"Expected 3.4.5-rc.1+build.10, got {result}"
